fullPassage: The reliance on the computer as a model for the operations of the human mind may well prove to be as limited as an earlier fascination with behaviorism. Psychologists have already begun to recognize the flaws of the mind-as-computer metaphor. Some have turned to cultural anthropology as a way of understanding the factors outside any particular individual's brain that help the individual make sense out of the world. Others, such as Jerome Bruner, one of the founders of cognitive psychology, find that the computer analogy carries with it an unfortunate shift "from the construction of meaning to the processing of information." Bruner's reflections on the limits of the machine model lead him back to a humanistic emphasis on narrative and story-telling as essential ingredients in understanding human cognition, a fascinating intellectual journey that reveals both the power and the limits of computers as guides to the way we think.

det.korean: Others find that — 복수 주어 Others에 맞는 동사 find.
det.analysis:
✅ find: Others(복수) + 복수 동사
❌ finds: 3인칭 단수 (수일치 오류)
❌ finding: 분사 (문장 동사 아님)
❌ founded: 설립하다의 과거분사 (의미 부적합)
det.tip: Others find that = 다른 이들은 ~을 발견한다

questions.passage: The reliance on the computer as a model for the operations of the human mind may well prove to be as limited as an earlier fascination with behaviorism. Psychologists have already begun to recognize the flaws of the mind-as-computer metaphor. Some have turned to cultural anthropology as a way of understanding the factors outside any particular individual's brain that help the individual make sense out of the world. Others, such as Jerome Bruner, one of the founders of cognitive psychology, find that the computer analogy carries with it an unfortunate shift "from the construction of meaning to the processing of information." Bruner's reflections on the limits of the machine model lead him back to a humanistic emphasis on narrative and story-telling as essential ingredients in understanding human cognition, a fascinating intellectual journey that reveals both the power and the limits of computers as guides to the way we think.
questions.stem: 윗글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인간 인지를 이해하려면 컴퓨터 모델을 넘어 서사와 인본주의적 접근이 필요하다.

❌ ③ 행동주의 부활: 원문에서 한계 사례로만 언급
❌ ④ 문화인류학이 유일한 대안: 하나의 접근일 뿐
